questions.text: A pole stands vertically on level ground. From point \(A\), the angle of elevation to its top is \(45^\circ\). After walking 20 meters directly away from the pole to point \(B\), the angle of elevation becomes \(\arctan\!\frac{2}{3}\). Find the height of the pole.

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.4 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q1
questions.text:
Let $\theta_n = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\right)$. Evaluate the exact value of the product:
$$ \cos(\theta_1) \cdot \cos(\theta_2) \cdot \cos(\theta_3) \cdots \cos(\theta_{99}) $$

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.4 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q2
questions.text:
Evaluate the exact value of the expression below (where the angle $5$ is measured in radians):
$$ \sin^{-1}(\sin 5) + \cos^{-1}(\cos 5) $$

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.4 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q3
questions.text:
Evaluate the exact value of the following nested composition, expressing your final answer in radians: 
$$ \cos^{-1}\left( \sin\left( \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right) + \tan^{-1}(1) \right) \right) $$

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.4 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q4
questions.text:
Using the reciprocal properties of inverse trigonometric functions, evaluate the exact value of:
$$ \sin\left(\sec^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{4}\right) + \csc^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{3}\right)\right) $$

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.4 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q5
questions.text:
Find the exact positive real number $x$ that satisfies the equation:
$$ \sin^{-1}(x) + \sin^{-1}(2x) = \frac{\pi}{2} $$

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.4 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q6
questions.text:
In a right triangle with a hypotenuse of length $10$, the two acute angles $\alpha$ and $\beta$ satisfy the equation:
$$ \tan^{-1}(\sin \alpha) + \tan^{-1}(\cos \beta) = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{8}{15}\right) $$
Find the exact length of the triangle's shortest leg.
